summary: Frontend-only retest of the 7 findings from iteration 43 plus 2 next-step spot checks. Run on the preview prod build as admin, sales and siteengineer, at 1440 and 390 px, in Light and Night. All 7 items pass. (1) On phones the tfoot totals row on /reports/outstanding-v2 and /reports/collections-v2 is now display:block and position:static, every cell is labelled, and it is readable in both themes. The /demands total row is static and labelled. /payments, /roznamcha and /documents render no tfoot, and nothing sticky sits over the cards. (2) /bookings/<id>?pay=1 opens Post payment once and the param is removed. Neither a reload nor Back reopens it. (3) After a refund was paid, 'Print refund letter' opened Documents › Generate with Ganesh Green Villas, Villa Block P and BK-2627-2466 selected, Cancellation / Refund letter active, and the preview frame loaded. (4) After a wizard save, sales gets only 'Print allotment letter'. The access-denied page reads 'Your role does not include this page. Ask an admin if you need it.' with no permission code. The site engineer's bill-letter gate was checked in code only, not live. (5) At 390, /users 'Invite user' sits at 14–139 px. /roznamcha, /settings, /settings/catalogues, /masters/company (Channel order) and a service request detail have nothing past the right edge, and there is 0 px sideways scroll. (6) The Reports hub Money group shows Overdue → Outstanding & Ageing, and each step line sits under its group name. (7) The wizard cost sheet shows 'from project setup', and 'Maintenance (advance)' fits at 1440. Spot checks: lead → Book site visit opened the visit dialog with the name and phone filled, and payment → Print / share receipt appeared.

issues: Square corners of the tfoot or td background show behind the rounded totals card: dark in Light, light in Night. Fix: set tfoot and its cells to background: transparent at max-width 767px.
The stacked cards sit inside an overflow:auto box with max-height 506 px (scrollHeight about 29,000), so phone users get a nested scroll. Consider dropping the max-height on phones.
The colSpan footnote row is labelled with the first column header 'Day ▸ Project ▸ Tower', because stackLabels maps labels by child index. Skip labels on cells with colSpan > 1.
The GST and Total amounts in the Agreement value row touch each other ('₹5,00,000₹1,05,00,000'), so the columns need a small gap.

action_items: Optional, cosmetic: make the phone tfoot or td background transparent so no square corners show behind the totals card.
Optional: remove the inner max-height scroll on report tables at phone widths.
Optional: in stackLabels.js, don't set data-label on colSpan cells.
critical_code_review_comments: stackLabels.js maps headers by child index, which is wrong for colSpan cells in tfoot and footnote rows.
Documents.jsx fetches /bookings/{id} only when project_id is missing, which is fine. It fails silently (catch → nothing), so a booking the user can't read leaves the Who card blank with no message.
BookingDetail.jsx ?pay=1: the param is removed even when the user lacks finance.payment.create, so nothing opens and no hint is shown. That is acceptable, because the prompt is already gated.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the retest items (7/7 pass; item 4's site-engineer part checked in code only) and 2/2 spot checks
